route.note: West then south to Lord Cobrahn
Kresh in the northern pool (optional but quick)
East along the channel to Verdan
Back to the Disciple of Naralex, start the escort
Follow the escort to Naralex; Mutanus spawns after two add waves

pulls.note: Anacondra with her druid escort; edge of her patrol only.
East caves: Verdan then Serpentis (kill the druid adds first).

strategies.text: Lightning Bolt on the tank, self Healing Touch, Sleep and Thorns. Pull from the edge of her patrol so the pack does not overwhelm the tank; kill druids before her.
Python adds die fast. Interrupt Druid's Slumber before the Healing Touch; at low health he shifts into serpent form and hits harder.
Same druid kit plus a Thunderclap. Stun and kill the adds first.
Plain tank and spank with a strong bite; high armour, so casters do better.
Hits very hard and roots the whole group with Grasping Vines. Healers focus the tank.
Final Druid of the Fang: two druid adds first, then him. Standard druid kit.
Only Chained Bolt; spread out to avoid extra damage.
Escort the Disciple (clear trash first). Two add waves, then Mutanus: Thundercrack stun, Terrify fear, Naralex's Nightmare (mind control or sleep). Keep a trinket or fear ward ready.
Harmless on its own; kill its druid escort first and watch for Slumber.

notes: uiMapID 279 is the retail 'Wailing Caverns' dungeon map; the table also lists 11 (micro) and 825. Verify in game with C_Map.GetBestMapForUnit. Mutanus is only reachable through Naralex's event; Method is unclear on exactly what unlocks the Disciple of Naralex (the four Druid bosses are the usual condition). Route order is a common clockwise clear, not the only valid one. The Deviate Faerie Dragon wanders and has no position here.
